signature: SUBROUTINE ZTGEVC( SIDE, HOWMNY, SELECT, N, S, LDS, P, LDP, VL,

params.name: side
howmny
SELECT
params.reference: If `HOWMNY='S'`, `SELECT` specifies the eigenvectors to be computed. The eigenvector corresponding to the j-th eigenvalue is computed if `SELECT(j)` = .TRUE.. Not referenced if `HOWMNY = 'A'` or 'B'.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrices S and P. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: S
params.reference: The upper triangular matrix S from a generalized Schur factorization, as computed by ZHGEQZ.

params.name: lds
params.reference: The leading dimension of array S. $\mathrm{LDS} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: P
params.reference: The upper triangular matrix P from a generalized Schur factorization, as computed by ZHGEQZ. P must have real diagonal elements.

params.name: ldp
params.reference: The leading dimension of array P. $\mathrm{LDP} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: VL
params.reference:
On entry, if `SIDE = 'L'` or 'B' and `HOWMNY = 'B'`, `VL` must contain an N-by-N matrix Q (usually the unitary matrix Q of left Schur vectors returned by ZHGEQZ). On exit, if `SIDE = 'L'` or 'B', `VL` contains: if `HOWMNY = 'A'`, the matrix Y of left eigenvectors of (S,P); if `HOWMNY = 'B'`, the matrix $Q \, Y$; if `HOWMNY = 'S'`, the left eigenvectors of (S,P) specified by

-   `SELECT`, stored consecutively in the columns of
-   `VL`, in the same order as their eigenvalues.

Not referenced if `SIDE = 'R'`.

params.name: ldvl
params.reference: The leading dimension of array `VL`. $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge 1$, and if `SIDE = 'L'` or 'l' or 'B' or 'b', $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge N$.

params.name: VR
params.reference:
On entry, if `SIDE = 'R'` or 'B' and `HOWMNY = 'B'`, `VR` must contain an N-by-N matrix Z (usually the unitary matrix Z of right Schur vectors returned by ZHGEQZ). On exit, if `SIDE = 'R'` or 'B', `VR` contains: if `HOWMNY = 'A'`, the matrix X of right eigenvectors of (S,P); if `HOWMNY = 'B'`, the matrix $Z \, X$; if `HOWMNY = 'S'`, the right eigenvectors of (S,P) specified by

-   `SELECT`, stored consecutively in the columns of
-   `VR`, in the same order as their eigenvalues.

Not referenced if `SIDE = 'L'`.

params.name: ldvr
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `VR`. $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge 1$, and if `SIDE = 'R'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge N$.

params.name: mm
params.reference: The number of columns in the arrays `VL` and/or `VR`. $\mathrm{MM} \ge M$.

params.name: m
params.reference: The number of columns in the arrays `VL` and/or `VR` actually used to store the eigenvectors. If `HOWMNY = 'A'` or 'B', M is set to N. Each selected eigenvector occupies one column.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
